title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 397 (Admissibility of certain documents as evidence)

content.overview: A document reproducing or derived from returns and documents filed with the Registrar, authenticated as prescribed, is admissible in evidence in proceedings under the Act.
content.glance: A document reproducing or derived from returns and documents filed with the Registrar, authenticated as prescribed, is admissible in evidence in proceedings under the Act.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 397 (Admissibility of certain documents as evidence). A document reproducing or derived from returns and documents filed with the Registrar, authenticated as prescribed, is admissible in evidence in proceedings under the Act. Apply only the conditions, approvals, filings and penalties stated in the section. A rule made under the Act cannot contradict the section. Not a verified closure.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: A document reproducing or derived from returns and documents filed with the Registrar, authenticated as prescribed, is admissible in evidence in proceedings under the Act.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: The section covers paper and electronic filings. Authentication by the Registrar or an empowered officer is the condition. It does not make an unauthenticated printout evidence.
